messages:
Diego - AE: FYI BlueHarbor again. They want a migration proposal from RivalAPI -> Redwood. Main asks: prompt parity, function-calling semantics, embeddings reindexing, and their legal team has a list of contractual/infosec bullets. Can we scope this quickly?
Nora - Solutions: Quick scan: RivalAPI auto-truncates to nearest sentence when stop sequences hit; they also add a choice-level `metadata` block in responses that customers rely on. We'll need a compatibility adapter to introduce that field and replicate truncation behavior.
Tomas (Runtime Eng): We can emulate truncation by post-filtering tokens before returning chunks, but streaming UX differs: Rival flushes every 256 bytes by default. We stream at token granularity; we can add a flush throttle to mimic.
Jin - InfoSec: Legal/infosec items we saw: 1) data retention / deletion SLA, 2) proof of key zeroization for KMS, 3) list of sub-processors, 4) whether we run inference on customer-dedicated infra in Private.
Ava - Legal: Also they asked about indemnities related to model outputs, plus jurisdiction clauses. We'll need their redlines; can't commit to much until we see specifics.
Diego - AE: They want an initial POC timeline and a rough one-off cost estimate. They suggested a 48-hour POC to validate parity for 1k prompts and a 50k-doc embeddings reindex.
Nora - Solutions: Proposed POC scope: - Build Rival-API-compatible proxy that rewrites requests and shapes responses - Replay 1k prompts and compare token-level diffs + top-5 output agreement - Reindex 50k docs and run recall/precision checks in their search app - Deliver a short report and recommended config changes (stop sequences, batch sizes, quantization profile)
Tomas (Runtime Eng): Engineering notes: proxy is small. Key risks: tokenizer edge cases can produce off-by-one token shifts; KV cache mismatch may change latencies. Reindexing 50k docs on standard gpus ~ estimate $3.5k-$6k depending on quantization and whether they want vector similarity service kept hot.
Nora - Solutions: For embeddings: Rival uses 2048-d float vectors with L2 norm; our default is 1024-d. So we must either 1) map + re-embed, or 2) provide a compatibility vector store that supports dual indexes. Re-embed is recommended for accuracy.
Diego - AE: Dual indexes could be long-term costly. Can we offer a migration discount or credits for the one-off reindex?
Ava - Legal: If we offer credits, mark it as promotional; mention not to change SLA terms. I'll draft an addendum template.
Jin - InfoSec: Security checklist for POC: require a narrow IAM role, dedicated temporary bucket with SSE, retention policy set to 30 days, and an audit log export. Also need to confirm whether they require HSM-backed keys. If yes, that's Private-only.
crm-bot: CRM update: Opportunity BlueHarbor (Enterprise) -> Stage: PoC scoping. Linked assets: https://crm.redwood/opps/BH-234 :spiral_calendar:
Diego - AE: Who can produce a short demo harness for parity comparisons? They want BLEU/ROUGE, token-shift heatmap, and a handful of side-by-side examples for their ML lead.
Tomas (Runtime Eng): I'll spin up a harness. Plan: replay 1k prompts, compute token delta histogram, BLEU/ROUGE, and capture 30 exemplars where outputs differ. Expect ~5-8% divergence initially due to tokenization and default stop handling. Prototype ready in 24 hours.
Nora - Solutions: I'll produce the adapter README and the migration checklist: endpoints mapping, sample request/response transformations, embedding reindex steps, caching guidance, and recommended parameter mappings (stop -> stop_sequences, truncate_mode -> sentence, stream_flush_bytes -> 256).
Diego - AE: Legal wants a short statement about data deletion for the POC. Can we commit to purge logs + vectors after 30 days?
Jin - InfoSec: We can commit for the POC to a 30-day deletion policy and provide a snapshot for audit. For anything beyond POC, need to discuss retention and longer-term agreements.
Ava - Legal: I'll put together a short POC Data Processing Annex with retention, sub-processors, and jurisdiction clauses. Send me the Rival migration checklist once drafted.
Diego - AE: Good. Action items: Tomas -> harness (24h), Nora -> adapter README + migration checklist (48h), Jin -> POC security checklist and deletion statement (24h), Ava -> POC annex draft (48h).
Tomas (Runtime Eng): Noted. I'll also include a small shim example customers can run locally; it will be under an internal repo but we can publish a sanitized OSS snippet later per policy.
Nora - Solutions: On the pricing front: runtime cost per token similar, but re-embedding + storage are one-time. For their 50k index I recommend budgeting $4k-$7k for reindexing and an incremental $200/month for vector storage depending on replication. I'll include a worked example in the checklist.
Diego - AE: Scheduling: Proposed demo with their ML lead Friday 11am PT. Can everyone confirm?
Tomas (Runtime Eng): Confirmed.
Nora - Solutions: Confirmed.
Jin - InfoSec: Confirmed.
Ava - Legal: Tentative but I'll try to join.
Diego - AE: Thanks. I'll send the Rival API spec and their legal questionnaire now. Please ping me if anything blocks scope or timeline. :thumbsup:
